question_record.context: On 2024-07-04, a malicious PowerShell Cmdlet was invoked on the machine `mb-winclient`. The malicious Cmdlet might be associated with credential theft, exploitation, network reconnaissance, or code injection. The related script `contosoadfsblatempcreds.ps1` was among the suspicious activities associated with user `bjenkins`.
question_record.question: What is the command line of the process that created, modified, or deleted a task using Task Scheduler as part of the suspicious Task Scheduler activity?
solution: A malicious PowerShell Cmdlet `powershell.exe` was invoked on the machine.

A process with Process ID `6892` used Task Scheduler at `2024-07-02t09:48:23.6453903z` with the command line `schtasks.exe /run /tn run-exportadfstokensignincert.2024-07-02_09_48_23` to create, modify, or delete a task, possibly for launching malicious code automatically and establishing persistence.

51.name: A malicious PowerShell Cmdlet was invoked on the machine
51.description: A malicious PowerShell Cmdlet was invoked on the machine. The Cmdlet may be associated with credential theft, exploitation, network reconnaissance or code injection.

33.name: Suspicious Task Scheduler activity
33.description:
A process involved in earlier malicious activity used Task Scheduler to create, modify, or delete a task. This might be an attempt launch malicious code automatically and establish persistence.

For further information on this threat, read the following threat analytics report: https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/c9709a39-ac8d-493d-9a63-71da3ca1e745/analystreport

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
